name: @pkg-runner/tray
description: Pkg Runner — tray + runner + screenshot (single process)
author: DeyaoCai

scripts.build:main: pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/assets build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tokens build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/wallpaper build && node ./scripts/build-main.mjs
scripts.build:dev: pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/assets build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tokens build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/wallpaper build && node ./scripts/build-main.mjs --dev
